correctness.rationale: A self-contained integral proof gives a link cell decomposition, a contractible core and primitive relative two-sphere basis; disjointly supported three-cube cycles produce a signed identity matrix in the relative homology for arbitrary distance-four codes. Exact sequences and connectedness/van Kampen/Hurewicz/Whitehead complete all-dimensional homotopy and primitive inclusion claims. All finite Hamming flag complexes through n=6 in the included tests passed independent combinatorial reconstruction and mod-2 chain checks; these do not replace the proof.

originality.rationale: No inspected prior source establishes or implies a simultaneous, all-dimensional deletion theorem for every separated binary code and all intermediate primitive integral maps. The 2021 ordered-initial-segment result covers one deletion; an earlier finite two-puncture result covers only n<=5; the new all-n and arbitrarily many nonlinearly configured punctures are not their corollaries. The recent cohomology paper concerns global structure and a separate group-action paper treats full-complex rational representations. Bibliographic incompleteness remains a stated priority risk.

value.rationale: Minimum distance four is natural in coding theory and precisely ensures an embedded three-cube around one removed point cannot contain another removed point. The theorem yields an arrangement-independent topological stability law and all integral inclusion maps for arbitrarily large non-linear codes, beyond the old one-site and low-dimensional two-site examples.
